logline: Before the elephants reach the lake, the sacred account opens on Trikūṭa, a vast mountain in the Ocean of Milk with gold, silver and iron peaks.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, Canto 8; passage checked against Vedabase verse pages (copyrighted translation not reused)
source.verification_notes: S01 uses only 8.2.1–4. Verse 1 identifies Śukadeva speaking to a king and Trikūṭa amid the Ocean of Milk; verses 2–3 describe the three gold, silver and iron peaks, other gem-rich peaks, vegetation and waterfalls; verse 4 describes ocean waves and emerald-colored foothills. These are originally written spoken paraphrases, not verbatim verse translations. Verse-level anchors point to the combined 8.2.2–3 page where appropriate. The subsequent garden, herd and lake are reserved for S02 and later scenes.

core_preserved: Śukadeva addresses a king while describing Trikūṭa, a large mountain surrounded by the Ocean of Milk (SB 8.2.1).
Trikūṭa has three principal peaks of gold, silver and iron, plus mineral- and jewel-rich secondary peaks, trees, vines, shrubs and waterfalls (SB 8.2.2–3).
Waves of the Ocean of Milk wash the foot of the mountain where emeralds make the ground green (SB 8.2.4).
changes: The narrator speaks an original accessible retelling rather than directly quoting Śukadeva or a modern published English translation.
The gold-left, silver-center, iron-right arrangement, aerial camera moves, ambient sound and transitions are original visual staging decisions; scripture does not assign peak positions.
The cosmic scale is conveyed pictorially without asserting a literal real-world map. No later garden, animals, lake or crocodile events are moved into S01.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Scripture-grounded geographic prologue with no dialogue ascribed to the king, Gajendra or a deity. All eight spoken lines are newly phrased paraphrases of cited verses. No new plot incident or moral has been added.

characters.description: Offscreen voice for the scriptural geographic prologue; not a visually present human or Śukadeva impersonation.
characters.voice_direction: Calm, clear and warmly curious, naming the three peaks distinctly and allowing waterfall and shoreline sounds to breathe; no voice actor has been selected.

scenes.title: The three peaks of Trikūṭa
scenes.setting: An island mountain surrounded by the Ocean of Milk: distant three-peak skyline, gem-studded smaller slopes, waterfalls and emerald-colored foothills. The garden, herd and freshwater lake are not shown yet.
scenes.action: A narrated opening vista moves from the Ocean of Milk and the immense mountain, through its three defining gold/silver/iron peaks, to the forested, waterfall-filled slopes and emerald shoreline. No named character appears on screen; later scenes will establish the separate Ṛtumat garden and the lake.
nonverbal_beats: Begin with a quiet, wide expanse of the Ocean of Milk before revealing Trikūṭa rising from it.

Read the three principal peaks in one silhouette; for a stable editorial screen map, stage gold left, silver center, iron right. Their screen positions are an original staging decision, not claimed as a verse detail.
Use one sustained rushing-water sound transition from jewel-bearing smaller peaks to waterfalls.
Finish with waves meeting emerald-green foothills. Do not show the Ṛtumat garden, Gajendra, herd, crocodile or the later freshwater lake yet.

shots.action: Open on an immense milky ocean, tilt up to Trikūṭa rising from its island; use offscreen narration L001–L002. No people or animals.
shots.camera: Extreme-wide 16:9 aerial establishing shot, slow rise; preserve mountain center and ocean around it.
shots.sound: Ocean surf underneath narrator; a restrained original ambient musical bed. No voices besides NARRATOR.

shots.action: Reveal the three primary peaks together and distinguish gold, silver and iron while narrator says L003–L004. Gold/silver/iron left-to-right is continuity staging only.
shots.camera: Wide frontal composition and slow lateral drift; keep all three peaks in a single stable view.
shots.sound: Wind at altitude and delicate, non-diegetic atmosphere under the narration.

shots.action: Move past smaller gem-bearing peaks, trees, vines, shrubs and waterfalls, ending at emerald-green foothills touched by Ocean of Milk waves; narration L005–L008. No lake, elephant, crocodile or invented incident.
shots.camera: Slow descending travel shot with gentle cut to shoreline; do not treat the ocean as the freshwater lake.
shots.sound: Distinct waterfall wash, then waves; leave a brief wordless tail for the transition to later S02.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Open the ancient setting through a calm, grounded narrator.

text.te: శుక మహర్షి ఒక రాజుకు ఓ అద్భుతమైన పర్వతం గురించి చెప్పారు. దాని పేరు త్రికూటం.
text.hi: शुकदेव मुनि ने एक राजा को एक अद्भुत पर्वत के बारे में बताया। उसका नाम था त्रिकूट।
text.en: Śukadeva told a king about a magnificent mountain called Trikūṭa.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Establish the mythic ocean and mountain scale.

text.te: దాని చుట్టూ క్షీరసాగరం ఉంది. ఆ సముద్రం మధ్య త్రికూటం ఎంతో ఎత్తుగా నిలిచింది.
text.hi: उसके चारों ओर क्षीरसागर था। उस समुद्र के बीच त्रिकूट बहुत ऊँचा खड़ा था।
text.en: The Ocean of Milk surrounded it, and Trikūṭa rose high above the waves.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.delivery: Name each distinct material without rushing

text.te: త్రికూటానికి మూడు ప్రధాన శిఖరాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఒకటి బంగారంతో, ఒకటి వెండితో, మరొకటి ఇనుముతో.
text.hi: त्रिकूट की तीन मुख्य चोटियाँ थीं—एक सोने की, एक चाँदी की और एक लोहे की।
text.en: Trikūṭa had three great peaks: one of gold, one of silver and one of iron.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Hold on the complete three-peak silhouette.

text.te: ఆ మూడు శిఖరాలు ఆకాశానికీ, చుట్టూ ఉన్న దిక్కులకీ అందం తెచ్చాయి.
text.hi: वे तीनों चोटियाँ आकाश और चारों दिशाओं की शोभा बढ़ाती थीं।
text.en: Those three peaks made the sky and every direction more beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Move from the main peaks to the smaller jewel-rich slopes.

text.te: ఇతర శిఖరాల్లో రత్నాలు, ఎన్నో రకాల ఖనిజాలు మెరిసేవి.
text.hi: दूसरी चोटियों पर तरह-तरह के रत्न और खनिज चमकते थे।
text.en: Other peaks held precious stones and many kinds of minerals.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Reveal the vegetation without adding new characters or events.

text.te: చెట్లు, తీగలు, పొదలు ఆ కొండలంతా విస్తరించాయి.
text.hi: पेड़, बेलें और झाड़ियाँ उन ढलानों पर फैली थीं।
text.en: Trees, climbing vines and shrubs spread across the slopes.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.delivery: Flowing, with a slight pause for the water sound
dialogue.intent: Let the waterfall sound bridge into the final shoreline view.

text.te: జలపాతాలు కిందికి పారుతూ, ఆ పర్వతమంతా నీటి శబ్దంతో మారుమోగేలా చేశాయి.
text.hi: झरने नीचे बहते थे, और उनके पानी की आवाज़ पूरे पहाड़ पर गूँजती थी।
text.en: Waterfalls poured down, and the sound of rushing water echoed across the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Complete the geographical reveal at the emerald-green foothills.

text.te: పర్వతం అడుగున క్షీరసాగరపు అలలు తాకుతున్నాయి. అక్కడి నేల పచ్చని మరకత రాళ్లతో మెరిసింది.
text.hi: पहाड़ की तलहटी को क्षीरसागर की लहरें छूती थीं। वहाँ की धरती हरे पन्नों से चमकती थी।
text.en: At the mountain’s foot, the ocean waves washed the shore, where green emeralds gleamed.

performance_notes: Eight original narration lines with 1:1 Telugu/Hindi/English meaning and stable IDs. NARRATOR owns every line; offscreen narration has lip_sync_target null. No character or animal vocalization in this scene. Pronunciation and natural language pacing require native-speaker table reads; no voices or recordings are approved.
timing_note: Scene 1 is a provisional 60 seconds split into three editorial shots of 18, 18 and 24 seconds. Eight English narration lines have a combined length appropriate for a scenic opening with pauses, but actual durations in Telugu/Hindi/English have not been recorded or measured. Five later scenes (S02–S06) remain unwritten; the 360-second episode target is not a measured runtime.
